The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have officially announced the Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) Recruitment 2026 with 11,127 openings. The detailed notification was published on 14 May 2026. Candidates who meet the age criteria of 18 to 30 years and hold Matriculation + ITI or Diploma/Degree in Engineering can now submit their online applications from 15 May 2026 to 14 June 2026. Direct links to download the notification and apply online are shared below.

FOLLOW US

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

The Railway Recruitment Boards have officially released Centralised Employment Notice (CEN) No. 01/2026 for recruitment to 11127 posts of Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) under various Railway Zones, Government of India. The notification includes complete details on vacancies, eligibility, selection process, examination syllabus, medical standards, fee, and application instructions. Candidates are strongly advised to download and read the full notification and its annexures before applying online. The notification PDF is available on all official RRB websites.

  • Download RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 Overview

Organization Name Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs), Ministry of Railways, Government of India

Medical Standard A-1 (Stringent vision and physical fitness standards; Lasik surgery candidates NOT eligible)
Application Mode Online only (via official RRB websites)
Selection Mode CBT-1 (75 marks) + CBT-2 (Part A: 100 marks + Part B: 75 marks qualifying) + CBAT + Document Verification + Medical Examination
Suitability for PwBD Not Suitable
Official Website Refer RRB-wise websites listed below (e.g., www.rrbald.gov.in, www.rrbmumbai.gov.in, etc.)

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

A total of 11127 vacancies have been announced for the post of Assistant Loco Pilot across all Railway Recruitment Boards and Zonal Railways. These are distributed across UR, SC, ST, OBC, and EWS categories. Ex-Servicemen (ExSM) vacancies are included within the total vacancy count and are not separately additional. The post is not suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD).

Category No. of Posts
UR (Unreserved) 4860
SC (Scheduled Caste) 1746
ST (Scheduled Tribe) 919
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 2598
EWS (Economically Weaker Section) 1004
Total 11127
Ex-Servicemen (ExSM) - included in above total 1115

RRB & Zone-wise Vacancy Details (Selected RRBs)

RRB Zone UR SC ST OBC EWS Total ExSM
Ahmedabad WR 62 22 11 38 14 147 15
Ajmer NWR + WCR 318 115 59 174 52 718 72
Mumbai CR + SCR + WR 336 219 106 380 152 1193 120

All RRBs Total 4860 1746 919 2598 1004 11127 1115

Note: Complete RRB & Zone-wise vacancy details are available in Annexure B of the official notification.

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the closing date of online application (14-06-2026). Educational/Technical qualification certificates must be from a recognized Board/University/Institute. Candidates awaiting results of their final examination for the prescribed qualification are NOT eligible to apply. The post of ALP is not suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD). Candidates who have undergone Lasik Surgery or any other corrective eye surgery are not eligible for this post.

Educational Qualification

Option Details
Option A - Matriculation + ITI Matriculation / SSLC plus ITI from recognised institutions of NCVT/SCVT in the trades of Fitter, Electrician, Instrument Mechanic, Millwright/Maintenance Mechanic, Mechanic (Radio & TV), Electronics Mechanic, Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), Wireman, Tractor Mechanic, Armature & Coil Winder, Mechanic (Diesel), Heat Engine, Turner, Machinist, Refrigeration & Air-Conditioning Mechanic. OR Matriculation / SSLC plus Course Completed Act Apprenticeship in the above trades.
Option B - Matriculation + Diploma/Degree in Engineering Matriculation / SSLC plus 3-year Diploma in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics / Automobile Engineering (or combination of these streams) from a recognised institution in lieu of ITI. Note: Degree in the above Engineering disciplines will also be acceptable in lieu of Diploma.

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Candidates must be between 18 and 30 years of age as on 01-07-2026. Age relaxation is available for various categories as detailed below. If a candidate is eligible for relaxation on more than one ground, only the maximum relaxation will be granted (not cumulative). SC, ST, and OBC (NCL) candidates applying against UR vacancies will not get any age relaxation. There is no fixed limit on the number of attempts - candidates can appear as long as they are within the prescribed upper age limit.

Category Age Limit / Relaxation
General (UR) & EWS 18 to 30 years (as on 01-07-2026)
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years relaxation (max 33 years)
SC & ST 5 years relaxation (max 35 years)
Ex-Servicemen (UR & EWS) 3 years after deduction of length of service from age
Ex-Servicemen (OBC-NCL) 6 years after deduction of length of service from age
Ex-Servicemen (SC & ST) 8 years after deduction of length of service from age
Serving Railway Staff (Group C/D) - UR & EWS Maximum 40 years of age
Serving Railway Staff (Group C/D) - OBC (NCL) Maximum 43 years of age
Serving Railway Staff (Group C/D) - SC & ST Maximum 45 years of age
Widowed / Divorced / Judicially Separated Women (UR & EWS) Maximum 35 years of age
Widowed / Divorced / Judicially Separated Women (OBC-NCL) Maximum 38 years of age
Widowed / Divorced / Judicially Separated Women (SC & ST) Maximum 40 years of age

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates are required to pay the non-refundable recruitment fee online. Fee can be paid only through online mode - internet banking, debit/credit cards, or UPI. Applications received without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected. Candidates who appear in CBT-1 will receive a refund of their examination fee (after deducting applicable bank charges) credited to their Aadhaar-seeded bank account. Candidates whose applications are rejected, or who do not appear in CBT-1, will not receive any refund.

Category Examination Fee Refund on Appearing in CBT-1
All Candidates (except categories below) Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only) Rs. 400/- refunded (deducting bank charges)
SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen / Female / Transgender / Minorities / Economically Backward Class (EBC) Rs. 250/- (Rupees Two Hundred and Fifty only) Rs. 250/- fully refunded (deducting bank charges)

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 consists of five successive stages - First Stage CBT (CBT-1), Second Stage CBT (CBT-2), Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT), Document Verification (DV), and Medical Examination (ME). CBT-1 is a screening exam only and its marks are not counted in the final panel. The final merit list is prepared on the basis of combined marks from Part-A of CBT-2 (50% weightage) and CBAT scores (50% weightage). Negative marking of 1/3rd mark per wrong answer applies in both CBT-1 and CBT-2. There is no negative marking in CBAT.

Stage 1 - First Stage CBT (CBT-1) - Screening Only

Details Particulars
Duration 60 Minutes
Total Questions / Marks 75 Questions / 75 Marks (1 mark per question)
Type Objective MCQ - Computer Based Test
Negative Marking 1/3rd mark deducted per wrong answer
Minimum Qualifying Marks UR & EWS: 40% | OBC (NCL): 30% | SC: 30% | ST: 25%
Shortlisting for CBT-2 15 times the vacancies notified per RRB (based on CBT-1 merit, RRB-wise)
Syllabus Mathematics, Mental Ability (Reasoning), General Science (10th standard level)

Stage 2 - Second Stage CBT (CBT-2)

Part Duration Questions Nature Minimum Qualifying Marks
Part-A 90 Minutes 100 Questions / 100 Marks Competitive - marks counted for merit UR & EWS: 40% | OBC (NCL): 30% | SC: 30% | ST: 25%
Part-B 60 Minutes 75 Questions / 75 Marks Qualifying only - trade-specific 35% for all candidates irrespective of category
Total Duration 175 Questions / 2.5 Hours  

Part-A Syllabus (CBT-2): Mathematics, General Intelligence and Reasoning, Basic Science and Engineering (Engineering Drawing, Units, Measurements, Basic Electricity, Levers, IT Literacy, etc.)

Part-B Syllabus (CBT-2) - Trade-wise Qualifying Test:

Sl. No. Qualification of Candidate Trade / Subject of Choice for Part-B
1 Electrical Engineering (and combinations) Electrician, Instrument Mechanic, Wireman, Armature & Coil Winder, Refrigeration and Air-conditioning Mechanic
2 Electronics Engineering (and combinations) Electronics Mechanic, Mechanic (Radio & TV)
3 Mechanical Engineering (and combinations) Fitter, Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), Tractor Mechanic, Mechanic (Diesel), Turner, Machinist, Refrigeration and Air-conditioning Mechanic, Heat Engine, Millwright/Maintenance Mechanic
4 Automobile Engineering (and combinations) Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), Tractor Mechanic, Mechanic (Diesel), Heat Engine, Refrigeration and Air-conditioning Mechanic

Stage 3 - Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT)

Shortlisting for CBAT 8 times the ALP vacancies per community/category per RRB (based on Part-A marks of CBT-2)
Qualifying Marks Minimum T-score of 42 in each test battery separately (all candidates irrespective of category)
Language English and Hindi only
Negative Marking No negative marking

Stage 4 & 5 - Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination (ME)

Final merit list is prepared RRB-wise from candidates qualifying in CBAT, with 50% weightage to Part-A of CBT-2 marks and 50% weightage to CBAT scores. Candidates equal to the number of vacancies are shortlisted for DV and Medical Examination. In case of a tie, the older candidate is preferred; if age is also equal, alphabetical order of given name (A to Z) is applied.

Tie-Breaking Rules

1st Tie-Break Seniority of age (older candidate preferred)
2nd Tie-Break Alphabetical order (A to Z) of given name (not surname)

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 - Medical Standards

The post of ALP carries Medical Standard A-1. Candidates must be physically fit in all respects with stringent vision requirements. Candidates who have undergone Lasik Surgery or any other corrective eye surgery are not eligible. A Self Screening Medical Declaration Report (Part-A signed by General Physician and Part-B signed by Eye Specialist, both from a Central/State Government Hospital or Medical College) must be submitted on the CBAT exam day.

Medical Standard General Fitness Vision Standards
A-1 Physically fit in all respects (i) Distant Vision: 6/6, 6/6 without glasses with fogging test (must not accept +2D); (ii) Near Vision: Sn: 0.6, 0.6 without glasses; (iii) Must pass tests for Colour Vision, Binocular Vision, Field of Vision, Night Vision, Mesopic Vision, etc.

How to Apply for RRB ALP Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the official websites of participating RRBs (listed at Para 13.7 of the CEN). Hard copy / offline applications will not be accepted under any circumstances. The online portal is active from 15-05-2026 to 14-06-2026 (23:59 Hrs.). Candidates must first create an account on the RRB portal. Those who created an account for CENs notified in 2024/2025 should use the same credentials. Details filled in the "Create an Account" form (including mobile number, email ID) and the chosen RRB cannot be modified at any stage after account creation. Candidates can apply to only one RRB and submit only one application - multiple applications to the same or different RRBs will result in rejection of all applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams. Aadhaar or DigiLocker authentication is strongly advised during account creation for a smoother recruitment process. A live photograph is captured during the online application; pre-existing photographs are not accepted. No documents need to be uploaded at application stage (except signature and SC/ST certificate for free travel pass, if applicable).

Documents to be Produced at Document Verification (on being called):

  • Age proof - Matriculation / SSLC / 10th class certificate
  • Educational qualifications (Matriculation onwards) - marksheets and certificates
  • ITI / Diploma / Degree certificate in prescribed trade / discipline
  • SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS / Ex-Servicemen certificate (if applicable), in prescribed format and issued by competent authority
  • Self Screening Medical Declaration Report (Annexure VIII A & VIII B) - to be submitted on CBAT day
  • NOC from present employer (if applicable, for Government servants)

Candidates are advised to regularly visit the official RRB website for their chosen RRB for updates on all stages. Helpline for technical queries: Email: [email protected] | Phone: 0172-565-3333 and 9592001188 (10:00 AM to 5:00 PM on working days).

Important Instructions for RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only one application per candidate is accepted - multiple applications to one or more RRBs will result in rejection of all applications and permanent debarment from RRB/RRC exams.
  • Candidates awaiting results of their final prescribed qualification examination are NOT eligible to apply.
  • Candidates who have undergone Lasik or any other corrective eye surgery are not eligible for the post of ALP.
  • Selection of RRB, once submitted, is final and cannot be changed at any later date.
  • Details filled in the "Create an Account" form (including mobile number, email ID) and chosen RRB cannot be modified at any stage after account creation.
  • Examination fee is refundable (after deducting bank charges) only to candidates who appear in CBT-1; rejected or absent candidates are not eligible for refund.
  • Refund will be credited only to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account; candidates must ensure their Aadhaar is linked to an active bank account.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

NHAI Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026: Get the latest National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) recruitment notification 2026 for 60 Deputy Manager (Technical) vacancies under the Ministry of Road Transport & Highways, Government of India. Selection is through GATE 2026 score in Civil Engineering discipline. The online application process starts on 15th May 2026 and the last date to apply online is 15th June 2026. Find NHAI vacancies on the official website nhai.gov.in. You can also get OnlyJobs of "Upcoming NHAI Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026" notifications for freshers and experienced candidates. Also know the direct official link for NHAI Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 apply online from the NHAI career page.

FOLLOW US

NHAI Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI), Ministry of Road Transport & Highways, has officially released a recruitment advertisement for 60 posts of Deputy Manager (Technical) in Level 10 of the Pay Matrix of 7th CPC on Direct Recruitment basis through GATE 2026 score in Civil Engineering. The notification includes complete details on vacancies, eligibility, age limit, PwBD sub-categories, selection process, service bond conditions, and application instructions. Candidates are strongly advised to read the full notification before applying online. The notification and any corrigendum/addendum will be published only on the official NHAI website.

  • Download NHAI Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF

NHAI Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026 Overview

Organization Name National Highways Authority of India (NHAI), Ministry of Road Transport & Highways, Government of India
Post Name Deputy Manager (Technical)
Total Vacancies 60 (including 04 PwBD posts)
Pay Scale Level-10 of Pay Matrix (7th CPC) - Rs. 56,100 to Rs. 1,77,500/- with Central Dearness Allowance (CDA)
Discipline Civil Engineering
Recruitment Mode Direct Recruitment through GATE 2026 Score (Civil Engineering discipline)
Application Mode Online only (via NHAI official website)
Service Liability All India - candidates willing to serve anywhere in India may only apply
Service Bond Rs. 5.00 Lakhs bond for a minimum service period of 3 years from date of joining
Official Website https://www.nhai.gov.in

NHAI Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Opening Date for Online Registration of Application 15-05-2026 (10:00 AM)
Last Date for Submission of Online Application 15-06-2026 (upto 6:00 PM)
Crucial Date for Age & Eligibility (General) 15-06-2026 (closing date of online application)
Crucial Date for Educational Qualification (Awaiting Result) 31-08-2026 (Degree / Provisional Degree Certificate must be submitted by this date)

NHAI Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

A total of 60 vacancies have been announced for the post of Deputy Manager (Technical) distributed across UR, SC, ST, OBC (NCL - Central List only), and EWS categories. Out of the total 60 posts, 04 posts are reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD). The number of posts advertised may increase or decrease as per the requirements of the Authority.

Category No. of Posts
UR (Unreserved) 26
SC (Scheduled Caste) 09
ST (Scheduled Tribe) 04
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer - Central List only) 16
EWS (Economically Weaker Section) 05
Total 60

PwBD Sub-Category Vacancy (Total 04 Posts out of 60)

Sl. No. Sub-Category of PwBD Post No. of Posts
1 Deaf (D) / Hard of Hearing (HH) 01
2 Special Learning Disability (SLD) / Mental Illness (MI) - including 01 current vacancy and 01 backlog vacancy 02
3 Multiple Disability (MD) involving more than one Benchmark Disability from the categories prescribed for this post - backlog vacancy 01

NHAI Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the closing date of online application (15-06-2026). The educational qualification required is a Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or Institute. Candidates whose result of the qualifying degree has not been declared by 15-06-2026 may also apply, but the offer of appointment will be issued only after submission of the provisional/final degree certificate to NHAI not later than 31-08-2026, failing which the candidature will be cancelled without any further notice. The post carries All India service liability. Candidates must hold a valid GATE 2026 score in Civil Engineering discipline.

Educational Qualification

Qualification Details
Essential Educational Qualification Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or Institute.
Mandatory Recruitment Criteria Valid GATE 2026 Score in Civil Engineering discipline.
Special Note (Awaiting Result) Candidates whose degree result is not declared by 15-06-2026 may apply. However, appointment will be offered only on submission of Degree / Provisional Degree Certificate to NHAI by 31-08-2026, failing which candidature will be cancelled.

NHAI Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Candidates must not exceed 30 years of age as on the closing date of online application (15-06-2026). Age relaxation is available for various categories as per Government of India instructions. If a candidate is eligible for more than one relaxation, only the highest permissible relaxation will be granted - concessions are not cumulative.

Category Age Relaxation
General (UR) / EWS Not exceeding 30 years (as on 15-06-2026)
SC / ST 5 years relaxation (max 35 years)
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years relaxation (max 33 years)
PwBD - General (UR) 10 years relaxation (max 40 years)
PwBD - OBC 13 years relaxation (max 43 years)
PwBD - SC / ST 15 years relaxation (max 45 years)
Ex-Servicemen (having rendered at least 5 years military service) 5 years relaxation

NHAI Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

No application fee is mentioned in the official notification. Candidates are advised to check the official NHAI website for any fee-related updates before submitting their application.

NHAI Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will be made purely on the basis of GATE 2026 score in Civil Engineering discipline. There is no written examination conducted by NHAI. In the event of a large number of applications, NHAI may adopt a shortlisting criteria and may call candidates for interaction/interview, if required. The mere possession of minimum qualifications does not entitle candidates to be considered for appointment. Selected candidates will have to execute a Service Bond of Rs. 5.00 Lakhs for a minimum service period of 3 years from the date of joining NHAI.

Tie-Breaking Rules

1st Tie-Break Date of birth - the candidate born earlier shall be placed higher in the merit list
2nd Tie-Break Alphabetical order (A to Z) of the first letter of the initial name (if date of birth is also same)

Service Bond Conditions

Bond Amount Rs. 5.00 Lakhs
Minimum Service Period 3 years from date of joining NHAI
Consequence of Early Resignation / Termination (within 3 years) Candidate shall be liable to pay Rs. 5.00 Lakhs to NHAI

How to Apply for NHAI Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the official NHAI website https://www.nhai.gov.in. Applications received through any other method will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. Candidates are advised to submit their online application well in advance without waiting for the closing date. In case of multiple applications, only the last application submitted will be considered and all earlier applications will be summarily rejected. Once submitted, candidates will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature. All communication from NHAI will be made through email only - candidates must furnish a correct and active email address.

Documents to be Uploaded at the Time of Online Application:

  • Scanned colour passport-size photograph (JPG / JPEG / PNG / GIF format, not exceeding 1 MB)
  • Scanned signature (JPG / JPEG / PNG / GIF format, not exceeding 1 MB)
  • Class X Certificate indicating date of birth (PDF format, not exceeding 2 MB)
  • Caste / Category Certificate - SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen as applicable, in prescribed format (PDF format, not exceeding 2 MB)
  • Certificate of passing Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering - Degree Certificate or Provisional Degree Certificate (PDF format, not exceeding 2 MB); candidates awaiting results should upload the same once declared, latest by 31-08-2026
  • GATE 2026 Score Card in Civil Engineering (PDF format, not exceeding 2 MB)

Apply Online at: https://www.nhai.gov.in → About Us → Recruitment → Vacancies → Current → Deputy Manager (Technical) → Online Application

For technical issues with the online application: Tel. No. 011-25074100 / 25074200 Extn. No. 1028 | Email: [email protected]

Important Instructions for NHAI Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Selection is purely on the basis of GATE 2026 score in Civil Engineering - candidates must hold a valid GATE 2026 score card.
  • The post carries All India service liability - only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply.
  • Candidates whose degree result is not declared by 15-06-2026 may apply but must submit the provisional/final degree certificate to NHAI by 31-08-2026, failing which candidature will be cancelled without notice.
  • Candidates who have completed their degree by the closing date must mandatorily upload the Degree Certificate or Provisional Degree Certificate - mere uploading of marksheets of all semesters will not suffice.
  • OBC candidates must submit an OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate issued during Financial Year 2026–27 (issued on or after 01-04-2026).
  • EWS candidates must possess an Income & Asset Certificate based on income for Financial Year 2025–26, issued on or after 01-04-2026.
  • PwBD candidates must possess a Disability Certificate certifying a minimum 40% disability issued by a Competent Authority.
  • No change in community/category status indicated in the online application will be allowed after submission.
  • Selected candidates must execute a Service Bond of Rs. 5.00 Lakhs for a minimum service period of 3 years from date of joining NHAI.
  • NHAI does not entertain transfer of service bonds for candidates already working in other Government organizations.
  • Canvassing or bringing influence in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • In case of multiple applications, only the last application submitted will be considered; all earlier applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature after submission of the application.
  • Any dispute in regard to any matter shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Delhi Courts only.
  • Corrigendum, addendum, or cancellation, if any, will be published only on the official NHAI website - candidates are advised to check regularly.

KRCL Mechanical Department Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for KRCL Mechanical Department Recruitment 2026 is through Walk-in Interview. Candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria may report directly for the walk-in interview at the specified venue with all original certificates and one copy of application in prescribed format (Annexure-A) along with one set of self-attested copies of all required certificates. Registration will be done between 09:00 hrs and 12:00 hrs only on the date of walk-in interview.

After preliminary screening of applications submitted in person, only provisionally eligible candidates will be interviewed. Group Discussion (GD) or any other elimination round like written test may be introduced depending on the number of candidates; only those who clear the elimination round will be called for further selection. The nominated Committee’s decision shall be final and binding. No train/bus fare/TA/DA shall be payable by KRCL for attending the walk-in interview. Candidates should come prepared to stay for a minimum of 2 days if required, at their own cost.

Stage Details
Preliminary Screening Verification of applications and documents submitted in person. Only provisionally eligible candidates allowed to proceed.
Elimination Round (if required) Group Discussion (GD) or Written Test may be introduced depending on number of candidates.
Interview By nominated Committee of KRCL. Merit list drawn based on performance in interview, qualification, and post-qualification experience.

How to Apply for KRCL Mechanical Department Recruitment 2026

Candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria may report directly for the walk-in interview at the venue on the specified date and time for their respective post. Candidates must fill and bring one copy of the application in the prescribed format (Annexure-A attached with the notification), available on the KRCL website at www.konkanrailway.com under Recruitment > Current Notifications. No online or offline application submission by post/courier is required – candidates must appear in person.

Registration time is strictly 09:00 hrs to 12:00 hrs only on the date of walk-in interview. Applications not conforming to the prescribed format or having illegible/ambiguous certificates or without certificates or incomplete will be summarily rejected. Any kind of canvassing will result in disqualification of the candidate at any stage of selection without assigning any reason.

Documents (Self-attested copies) to be attached with the filled application form:

  • Copies of certificate in proof of qualification (as per the qualification specified in the Notification Annexure)
  • Copy of proof of Date of Birth (SSLC/SSC Certificate/Birth Certificate)
  • Copy of Caste certificate in support of claims, if any (OBC-NCL certificate in prescribed Central Government format; certificate not indicating validity will not be accepted)
  • Copy of service certificate in support of claims for Ex-servicemen, if any
  • Experience Certificate issued by previous employer
  • Two passport size recent photographs
  • Character certificate from Gazetted Officer/Executive Officer certifying good moral character

All original certificates must also be brought for verification at the time of the walk-in interview. Selected candidates will be required to pass a prescribed medical examination before the contract is entered into. Selected candidates must be able to join within a maximum of 30 days after issuance of offer of appointment. Selected candidates will be required to execute an agreement and indemnity bond of Rs. 50,000/- in favour of KRCL on stamp paper of Rs. 100/- or more.

Walk-in Interview Venue: Administrative Building, Wagon Repair Workshop, Autonagar, Vadlapudi, Gajuwaka, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.

Important Instructions for KRCL Mechanical Department Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Candidates must ensure they fulfill the eligibility criteria before attending the walk-in interview for a particular post.
  • Registration time is strictly 09:00 hrs to 12:00 hrs only on the date of the walk-in interview; late arrivals will not be registered.
  • Candidate can appear for interview at this one venue only; no TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview.
  • This engagement is on a fixed term contract basis and shall not result in regular/permanent absorption in KRCL service. Candidates must give an undertaking in writing to KRCL to this effect.
  • Selected candidate can be posted and transferred at any time, anywhere to the KRCL establishment during the contract period.
  • Contract may be terminated by giving one month’s notice from either side or payment in lieu thereof. Contract can be terminated without notice if performance is not satisfactory.
  • No accommodation will be provided and no Food/Mess Allowance will be paid by KRCL.
  • Even after contractual agreement, if any document/certificate/information is found incorrect or false, contractual service will be immediately terminated without prior notice, besides legal action.
  • Candidates who are already working in KRCL on contract basis and selected against this notification do not require to follow the condition of notice period for joining the new post; however, a relieving letter from the concerned Konkan Railway authority will be required at the time of joining.
  • The Corporation reserves the right to cancel/restrict/curtail/enlarge the contract engagement process without any prior notice and without assigning any reason.
  • Any kind of canvassing will result in disqualification of the candidate at any stage of selection without assigning any reason.
  • Statutory Income Tax, Professional Tax, and other applicable taxes will be deducted at source.
  • The information on KRCL’s website www.konkanrailway.com at its link Recruitment > Current Notifications should be checked for updates.

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the cut-off date 01-05-2026. Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Freshers with the relevant educational qualification are eligible to apply; prior experience is not mandatory. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the eligibility criteria prescribed for the post before applying.

The selected candidates will be paid a total CTC of Rs. 30,000/- per month (inclusive of statutory deductions) along with other applicable allowances as detailed below. IRCTC Hospitality Monitor Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for IRCTC Hospitality Monitor Recruitment 2026 is through Walk-in Interview. Candidates are required to fill in the application form (attached with the notification) and submit it at the venue of the interview along with original documents, one set of attested photocopies of required documents, and two recent passport size photographs. Based on credentials and performance in the personal interview, candidates will be shortlisted. The offer of engagement shall be issued to suitable candidates in order of merit and based on number of vacancies, subject to verification of antecedents.

Engagement is subject to the candidate being medically fit as prescribed by IRCTC. The contract may be terminated by giving one month’s notice by either side. If performance during the contract period is not found satisfactory, the contract may be terminated without any notice.

IRCTC Hospitality Monitor Recruitment 2026 - Scope of Work

Selected Hospitality Monitors will be responsible for a range of supervisory and monitoring duties across mobile/static catering units operated by IRCTC. Key responsibilities include supervision and monitoring of food production, quality and services; ensuring compliance of company policies and standard hospitality procedures; ensuring proper manpower and materials for nominated catering units; resolving customer/passenger care related issues and effective complaint management; collecting feedback, analysis and course correction; ensuring statutory compliance and regulations; supervising and educating staff in efficient upkeep of equipment and devices; and coordinating with various departments, offices, and business partners.

How to Apply for IRCTC Hospitality Monitor Recruitment 2026

Candidates are required to fill in the application form (Proforma attached with the official notification) duly complete in all respects and submit it at the venue of the walk-in interview. No online application process is involved - candidates must appear in person at any one of the listed venues on the specified dates. The completed application form has to be submitted at the venue for verification along with original documents, one set of attested copies of requisite documents, and two recent passport size photographs.

Those working in Government/PSUs may apply through proper channel or submit NOC at the time of interview or should submit a proper relieving letter from their present employer in the event of selection in IRCTC. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the walk-in interview. Candidate can appear for interview at any one convenient place only.

  • Any other relevant documents

In absence of any of the above documents in original, the candidate will not be allowed to appear in the walk-in interview. Candidates should carry one set of self-attested photocopy of all above documents along with all originals.

Indian Army TES-56 Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Indian Army TES-56 Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for Indian Army TES-56 Recruitment 2026 consists of multiple successive stages – shortlisting of applications based on JEE Mains CRL, SSB Interview (five days), Medical Examination, Merit List, and finally issuance of Joining Letter. Candidates who qualify the SSB will be called for Medical Examination. The final merit list is based solely on marks obtained in the SSB Interview.

Merely qualifying at the SSB interview does not confirm final selection. If any candidate fails to report at the allotted CTW within 07 days from the allotted date of reporting, their candidature will be cancelled and the next candidate in merit will be upgraded to fill the vacancy.

Stage 1 - Shortlisting of Applications

JEE Mains 2026 Common Rank List (CRL) Cut-off to be fixed by Integrated HQ of MoD (Army) without assigning any reason. Shortlisting result tentatively in first week of July 2026.

Stage II Group Testing Officer tests and Interview by Interviewing Officer. Only those clearing Stage I proceed to Stage II.

Likely SSB Dates August to September 2026

Stage 3 - Medical Examination

Candidates recommended by SSB will undergo Medical Examination at the nearest Military Hospital. Medical standards as applicable for Officers Entry into Army. Proceedings of Medical Board are confidential.

Stage 4 - Merit List & Joining Letter

Phase-II consists of 1 year of Integrated Basic Military Training & Engineering Training at Indian Military Academy (IMA), Dehradun. On successful completion of 4 years of training, cadets will be awarded an Engineering degree and granted Permanent Commission in the rank of Lieutenant.

On successful commissioning, the pay of the officer shall be fixed at the first cell of Level 10 in the Pay Matrix. The training period shall not be treated as commissioned service.   • Any canvassing directly or indirectly by the applicant will disqualify their candidature.
  • Any information or communication regarding changes in the advertisement will be published on the Company's website only. Candidates must regularly check https://www.balmerlawrie.com for updates.
  • All decisions of the Company regarding eligibility, selection, and other matters are final and binding. No correspondence shall be entertained.
  • The court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Kolkata.

Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026 involves scrutiny of applications, written test, and skill/practical/physical test wherever applicable. All applications will be scrutinised in terms of age limit, minimum qualification, documents and certificates. Eligible candidates will be issued call letters for the written test. Merely fulfilling basic selection criteria does not automatically entitle a person to be called for test. Selected candidates will be subject to "All India Service Liability".

Selection Process Stages:

Stage Details
1. Scrutiny of Applications Pre-scrutiny in terms of age limit, minimum qualification, documents and certificates by the respective unit before calling candidates for the written test
2. Written Test 100% weightage; Question cum answer paper will be in English and Hindi; Simultaneous conduct of test for all categories
3. Skill / Practical / Physical Test Qualifying in nature; Required candidates shortlisted based on merit/category in written test will be called for this test

Written Test Syllabus (Post-Wise):

Post Name Syllabus / Subjects
Lower Division Clerk (LDC) / Hindi Typist
  • General Intelligence
  • English Language
  • Numerical Aptitude
  • General Awareness
Civilian Mechanical Transport Driver – Ordinary Grade (CMTD)
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning
  • Numerical Aptitude
  • General English
  • General Awareness
  • Trade/Post related questions

Important Notes on Selection:

  • Question cum answer paper will be in English and Hindi
  • There will be simultaneous conduct of test for all categories
  • The responsibility of deciding the category for which the candidate would like to appear will be the choice of the applicant himself
  • No separate exam will be conducted for candidates applying for more than one category if the exams are held on the same date
  • The centre for examination/skill/practical/physical test will be intimated to the candidate in due course and may be different from the place to which the application was sent

How to Apply for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026

The application process for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Eligible candidates can apply to any of the Air Force Stations of their choice subject to the vacancies and qualifications. The application as per Annexure-I (prescribed proforma given in the advertisement), duly supported with required documents, must reach the concerned Air Force Station as per choice within 30 days from the date of publication of this advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar (i.e., by approximately 01-06-2026).

Steps to Apply Offline:

  1. Step 1: Download Notification & Application Form - Download the Employment News notification PDF and extract the Application Form (Annexure-I) from the official notification
  2. Step 2: Fill Application Form - Download and fill the Application Form as per the prescribed Proforma (Annexure-I). The application form must be filled/typed in English or Hindi only
  3. Step 3: Affix Photograph - Affix a recent passport-size self-attested photograph on the application form. Also attach two additional passport-size photographs (same as affixed on the form)
  4. Step 4: Prepare Required Documents - Attach self-attested copies of all documents:
    • Educational qualification certificates (10th/12th/Diploma as applicable)
    • Age proof certificate (10th certificate/birth certificate)
    • Technical qualification certificates (if applicable)
    • Valid Civil Driving Licence (for CMTD post - for light and heavy vehicles)
    • Experience certificate (minimum 2 years for CMTD post)
    • Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) certificate issued by competent authority (if applicable)
    • Caste Certificate issued by competent civil authorities for SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates
    • OBC certificate stating non-creamy layer status (for OBC candidates seeking reservation)
    • Discharge book (self-attested photocopy for ex-servicemen)
    • EWS certificate valid for Financial Year 2026-2027 (issued on the basis of income for FY 2025-2026)
  5. Step 5: Attach Self-Addressed Envelope - Attach a self-addressed envelope with stamps of Rs. 10/- pasted. Address should be typed in English/Hindi
  6. Step 6: Prepare Envelope for Posting - Put all documents in an envelope. Mention clearly on the envelope: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF AND CATEGORY "
  7. Step 7: Send by Post - Send the complete application by post to the concerned Air Force Station/Unit's postal address (as mentioned in the official notification for the chosen station) within 30 days from the date of publication

Important Notes for Application:

  • Candidates intending to apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post
  • Applications received prior to the date of publication and after the closing date will not be entertained and will be rejected
  • IAF will not be held responsible for any postal delay
  • All documents must be self-attested
  • Application form must be duly typed in English/Hindi with a recent passport-size photograph

Documents Required with Application:

  • Duly filled Application Form (Annexure-I) typed in English/Hindi
  • Recent passport-size self-attested photograph affixed on application + 2 additional photographs
  • Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates
  • Self-attested copy of age proof certificate
  • Valid Civil Driving Licence (for CMTD post)
  • Experience certificate (for CMTD post - minimum 2 years)
  • PwBD certificate (if applicable)
  • Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS as applicable)
  • OBC non-creamy layer certificate (for OBC candidates)
  • Discharge book copy (for ex-servicemen)
  • Self-addressed envelope with Rs. 10/- stamps pasted

Send Application by Post to: The respective Postal Address of the concerned Air Force Station/Unit as mentioned in the official Employment News notification for the chosen station.

Note: Detailed station-wise postal addresses are available in the official Employment News notification PDF (Advt. No. 01/2026).

Important Instructions for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only Indian Citizens are eligible to apply
  • Age limit: 18 to 25 years (age relaxation as per category)
  • Crucial date for age and document validity: Last date of receipt of application
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against unreserved posts are not entitled to any relaxation in age limit, experience, etc.
  • OBC candidates seeking reservation must submit certificate stating they do not belong to creamy layer and their caste should be listed under Central List of OBCs
  • EWS candidates must ensure that the Income & Asset Certificate is valid for Financial Year 2026-2027 (issued on the basis of income for FY 2025-2026)
  • PwBD candidates with temporary disability (falling under "likely to improve" category) as per Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment OM No. 18-25/2024-Policy dated 17 Dec 2025 are not eligible for reservation. Only "progressive, non-progressive or not likely to improve" PwBD candidates are eligible for reservation

  • The option for scribe to PwBD candidates will be applicable as per DoPT OM No. 29-6/2019-DD-III dated 10 Aug 2022

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs

Eligibility for forest department jobs depends on the post, state and recruitment authority. Below is a general idea of qualification and age for popular posts like Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer. Candidates should always check the official notification for detailed eligibility criteria.

Education Qualification for Forest Guard, Forester, Ranger

  • Forest Guard / Field Guard / Forest Watcher / Beat Guard: Usually 10th pass or 12th pass from a recognized board, knowledge of local language, and basic physical standards as per state rules.
  • Forester / Section Forest Officer / Deputy Forest Ranger: Generally 12th pass or graduate in any stream or science-related subjects, with physical standards and sometimes driving or technical skills depending on the post.
  • Forest Range Officer (RFO) / Forest Ranger / ACF: Normally graduate degree in Science, Agriculture, Forestry, Environmental Science, Engineering or related disciplines, with higher physical standards and sometimes a competitive exam similar to state PCS level.
  • IFS / Indian Forest Service and senior posts (DCF, CF, CCF, PCCF): Filled through UPSC Indian Forest Service Examination and promotions, requiring a graduate degree and all-India competitive selection.

Age Limit & Relaxation

  • Forest Guard / Forester / Field Guard: Minimum age is usually 18 years and maximum age is around 27–30 years, with age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, EWS, Ex-servicemen and other categories as per government rules.
  • Forest Range Officer / ACF and higher competitive posts: Age limit often ranges from 21 to 32 years (varies by recruitment), with relaxations for reserved categories.
  • Exact age limit, cut-off date and relaxation details always depend on the particular notification, so candidates should verify from the official advertisement before applying.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern

The selection process for Forest Department Jobs 2026 typically includes written examinations, physical tests and document verification. Some posts also conduct medical examination and walking tests due to the demanding nature of field duties.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  • Written Exam: Most Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer recruitments start with a written exam based on objective-type questions (MCQs).
  • PET / PST (Physical Efficiency Test / Physical Standard Test): Candidates who qualify written exam are called for running, walking test, height, chest measurement and other physical parameters as per post and gender.
  • Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must produce original certificates of age, qualification, caste, residence, sports/NCC and other documents mentioned in the notification.
  • Medical Examination: Many forest posts require medical fitness to ensure candidates can perform field duties in forests, wildlife areas and difficult terrain.

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

Typical syllabus for written exam may include:

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs (national, state-level, environment and forest-related topics)
  • General Hindi / English or regional language (grammar, comprehension, vocabulary)
  • General Mathematics / Quantitative Aptitude (up to 10th or 12th level)
  • General Science and Environmental Studies (forest, wildlife, biodiversity, conservation, climate, basic biology)
  • Reasoning Ability (logical and analytical reasoning)

Exact subject-wise marks, number of questions, negative marking and exam duration will be given in the respective forest department notification.

  2. Find the latest link for Forest Guard / Forester / Forest Range Officer / other forest posts and open the detailed advertisement.
  3. Complete the registration process with basic details like name, mobile number, email ID and verify using OTP if required.
  4. Fill the online application form with personal, educational, address and category information exactly as per documents.
  5. Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature and other certificates in the prescribed format and size.
  6. Pay the application fee online through Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI as per your convenience.
  7. Finally, submit the form and take a printout or PDF of the submitted application and payment receipt for future reference.

  • Valid ID proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, Passport, etc.)

WAPCOS Limited has officially released Advertisement No. WAP/EXPT/TPI-RDSS/2026-27/01 dated 11/05/2026 for engagement of Experts on Project Term Basis for work relating to various Projects under RDSS (Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme). WAPCOS RDSS Expert Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

Candidates must fulfill the qualification and experience requirements as on 30-04-2026. The educational qualification must be from a recognized university/institution. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PWBMD candidates shall be applicable as per Government rules. Applications submitted in formats other than the WAPCOS prescribed proforma will be rejected. Self-attested photocopies of all supporting documents (Date of Birth, Qualification, Experience, Category proof) must accompany the application.

IAF AFCAT 02/2026 - Branch, Course Number and Vacancy Details

Actual intake would depend on organizational requirements, various cadre control mechanisms, availability of training slots, and actual number of vacancies accruing in July 2027. No representation in this regard will be entertained. Two seats are reserved from Ground Duty (Non-Technical) vacancies for Law qualified candidates.

IAF AFCAT 02/2026 - Type of Commission

Type Details
Permanent Commission (PC) – Men & Women Candidates joining as PC would continue to serve till the age of superannuation in their respective branches as per their rank.
SSC – Flying Branch (Men & Women) Engagement period for Flying Branch SSC officers is 14 years from the date of commissioning.
SSC – Ground Duty Technical & Non-Technical (Men & Women) Initial tenure for SSC officers in Ground Duty branches would be for a period of 10 years. An extension of 4 years may be granted subject to service requirements, availability of vacancies, willingness, suitability, and merit.
Grant of PC (at a later date) Considered subject to service requirements, availability of vacancies, willingness, suitability, merit, and as per prevailing policies on the subject.

Note: SSC officers are not entitled for grant of pension.

IAF AFCAT 02/2026 - Eligibility Criteria (Age)

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on 01 July 2027. All age calculations are done with reference to 01 July 2027.

Branch / Entry Age Limit
Flying Branch (AFCAT Entry) 20 to 24 years as on 01 July 2027 (born between 02 July 2003 and 01 July 2007, both dates inclusive). Upper age limit for candidates holding valid and current Commercial Pilot Licence issued by DGCA (India) is relaxable up to 26 years (born between 02 July 2001 to 01 July 2007, both dates inclusive).
Ground Duty (Technical & Non-Technical) – AFCAT Entry and Ground Duty (Technical) – GATE Score Entry 20 to 26 years as on 01 July 2027 (born between 02 July 2001 and 01 July 2007, both dates inclusive).

IAF AFCAT 02/2026 - Educational Qualifications

Details on physical/medical standards, educational qualifications, and the full selection procedure are available in the detailed notification on the website. Candidates are advised to visit the official AFCAT website for branch-wise educational qualification requirements.

Branch Educational Qualification (General)
Flying Branch Graduation with Physics and Mathematics at 10+2 level, or BE/B.Tech degree. (Refer official notification for full details.)
Ground Duty (Technical) BE/B.Tech in relevant engineering disciplines. GATE Score Entry candidates must have valid GATE scores in specified disciplines. (Refer official notification for full details.)
Ground Duty (Non-Technical) Graduation in relevant discipline as per the sub-branch (Administration, Logistics, Accounts, Education, Meteorology, Weather Service). (Refer official notification for full details.)

IAF AFCAT 02/2026 - Pay, Allowances & Privileges

IAF Offers the following pay and benefits on commissioning as per 7th CPC:

Rank Pay as per Defence Matrix Level MSP (Military Service Pay)
Flying Officer Rs. 56,100 – 1,77,500/- 10 Rs. 15,500/-

Note: Flight Cadets shall receive a fixed stipend of Rs. 56,100/- per month during one year of training.

Allowances: On commissioning, allowances are applicable based on the branch/nature of posting including Flying Allowance, Transport Allowance, Technical Allowance, Test Pilot & Flight Test Engineer Allowance, Risk and Hardship Allowance, etc.

Privileges: Air Force Officers are entitled to furnished accommodation, comprehensive medical cover for self and dependents, Canteen, Officers' Mess, loans at subsidised rates, LTC, Leave (60 days annual and 20 days casual), subject to service exigencies.

Insurance: Mandatory Insurance Cover is applicable for IAF Officers through Air Force Group Insurance Society (AFGIS). Group Insurance for death while in service is Rs. 1.25 Crore (on contribution). Similarly, PC Officers retiring from service after rendering 20 or more years of service and SSC Officers who have completed 14 years of service are covered under Air Veterans Insurance Cover (AVIC) for Rs. 24 Lacs initially for 15 years, after retirement. The annual transfer for this is Rs. 12 Lacs till the age of 75 years.

Entry Type Examination Fee
AFCAT Entry (Men & Women) Rs. 550/- + GST (Non-Refundable)
NCC Special Entry NIL (No Examination Fee)
GATE Score Entry NIL (No Examination Fee)

IAF AFCAT 02/2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for IAF AFCAT 02/2026 is merit-based. Candidates registering for AFCAT entry will have to pay the examination fee and appear for the AFCAT Online Test conducted at various centres. Details of conduct of exam, examination centres, and mode of payment are available in the notification.

Stage Process
Stage 1 AFCAT Online Examination / NCC Special Entry / GATE Score Screening
Stage 2 Air Force Selection Board (AFSB) Interview (including Psychological Test, Group Tests, and Interview) at various AFSB centres
Stage 3 Medical Examination at Air Force Central Medical Establishment (AFCME) / Institute of Aviation Medicine (IAM)
Stage 4 Final Merit List and Joining Instructions

Physical Conditioning: Candidates are advised to be physically fit when reporting for SSB. Aim to achieve an ability to run 01 mile (1.6 km) in 10 minutes, do 10 push-ups and 03 chin-ups. Prospective candidates are also advised to keep themselves in good physical condition by training at RFA which encompasses running, swimming, rope climbing, and other forms of physical training/conditioning. Mandatory tests are conducted during training.

How to Apply for IAF AFCAT 02/2026 Recruitment

Interested candidates should log on to https://afcat.cdac.in to apply. No other means/mode of application shall be accepted. Candidates are required to possess a valid email ID and active mobile phone number throughout the selection process. Online registration will open on 20-05-2026 (1100 Hrs) and close on 19-06-2026 (2330 Hrs).

Candidates eligible for one or more entries are required to register separately for each entry. After applying online, the candidate is required to download the application slip generated by the system with a unique application number. Information filled in by candidates in the online application form will be considered final and no amendments will be allowed subsequently. Candidates should exercise due care while entering their date of birth.

Important Points Before Registration:

  • Candidates must maintain their unique registered Email ID and mobile phone number active throughout the selection process.
  • PAN Card and account in SBI/Nationalised Bank is mandatory at the time of joining Air Force Academy.
  • Aadhaar Card is mandatory for registration.
  • Candidates must be unmarried at the time of commencement of the course. Marriage during the period of training shall result in discharge and liability to refund all expenditure incurred by the Government.

Apply Online at: https://afcat.cdac.in

For Queries: Related to conduct of online examination, registration process, and admit cards — contact +91 9513252077 or E-Mail [email protected]. For queries regarding eligibility, allotment of AFSB centres, conduct of AFSB interview, merit list, and Joining Instructions — contact 011-23010231 Extn 7610 or Toll free number 1800-11-2448.

Important Instructions for IAF AFCAT 02/2026 Candidates

  • Only Indian Citizens as per Citizenship Act 1955 are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates must be unmarried at the time of commencement of the course.
  • Permanent body tattoos are not permitted on any other body part except on the inner face of forearms (elbow to wrist) and on the reverse side (palm/back dorsal) of both hands. Self-declaration certificate is mandatory for small innocuous tattoos that are not prejudicial to good order and military discipline.
  • Use/possession of narcotics is banned. Candidates found using narcotics at any time during training will be debarred from joining the IAF.
  • Information filled in online application is final — no amendments allowed subsequently. Exercise due care while entering date of birth.
  • Travel Allowance (TA) to and fro for travelling to AFSB will be reimbursed at AC-III Tier/AC Chair Car or actual normal bus fare for first-time candidates. No TA is admissible if you have already appeared for the same type of entry at any of the Selection Boards.
  • Candidates must furnish correct and active Saving Bank Account details (not SB Account like Sukanya Samridhi etc.) for transfer of TA claims.
  • Candidates are advised to keep themselves regularly updated through the official AFCAT website regarding all selection process alerts.
  • Selection in the Indian Air Force is fair and merit-based. Any attempt to influence the selection process at any stage or use of any unfair means like forgery, impersonation, or supplying false information is liable to lead to termination of candidature or initiation of service and legal action against the candidate.
  • Terms and conditions given in the advertisement are only guidelines and are subject to change without notice.

Selection Process

The recruitment process will consist of Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Physical Standards Test (PST), Computer Based Test (CBT), Trade/Skill Test, Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination (DME/RME).

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Qualifying in nature.
    • For Constable (Driver, Motor Mechanic Vehicle, Gardner, Painter, Carpenter, Brass Band, Pipe Band, Cobbler, Tailor & Bugler): Male – 5 Kms race in 24 minutes; Female – 1.6 Kms in 8.30 minutes.
    • For Constable (Cook/Water Carrier, Barber & Hair Dresser, Washer man & Washer women, Safai Karmachari): Male – 1.6 Kms in 10 minutes; Female – 1.6 Kms in 12 minutes.
    • For Pioneer Wing (Mason / Electrician): Male – 1.6 Kms in 09 minutes.
    • Pregnant women candidates will be declared temporarily unfit.
  • Physical Standards Test (PST): Height, Chest (for males only) & Weight (proportionate to height & age).
    • Height: Male – 170 Cms (minimum); Female – 157 Cms (minimum). Relaxations applicable for certain categories (ST, NE States, Gorkhas, etc.).
    • Chest (Male only): Un-expanded – 80 Cms, Minimum expansion – 05 Cms. Relaxations applicable.
    • Candidates failing PST will be eliminated.
  • Computer Based Test (CBT): 100 marks (100 MCQs), duration 02 hours.
    • General Intelligence & Reasoning – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • General Knowledge & General Awareness – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • Elementary Mathematics – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • English/Hindi – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • Negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.
    • Qualifying marks: UR – 30%, EWS/OBC – 25%, SC/ST & others – 20%.
    • Marks will be normalized. Merit list prepared on CBT marks.
  • Trade/Skill Test: Qualifying in nature (50 marks, minimum 20 marks required). Practical assessment of the applied trade/post.
  • Document Verification (DV): Original documents (Matric certificate, Domicile/PRC, Trade certificates, Caste/EWS/ESM certificates, etc.) will be verified.
  • Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME): As per Uniform Guidelines issued by MHA. Temporary unfitness allowed only for pregnancy. Final selection subject to medical fitness.
  • Final merit list prepared on the basis of marks obtained in CBT (subject to qualifying all stages). Separate merit lists for male/female and each State/UT (All India basis for Pioneer posts).

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through CRPF website. No other mode will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit the official website www.rect.crpf.gov.in.
  2. Click on the link for “Recruitment for the post of Constable (Technical & Tradesmen and Pioneer) 2026”.
  3. Register by providing basic details and generate Provisional Registration Number & Password.
  4. Fill the online application form carefully (personal details, educational qualification, trade/post applied, State/UT of domicile, etc.).
  5. Upload scanned copies of recent colour passport size photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as per specifications.
  6. Pay the application fee online (if applicable) through BHIM, UPI, Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card or CSC Wallet.
  7. Submit the application and take printout of the application form & e-receipt for future reference.
  8. Candidates should bring two coloured printouts of the Admit Card at every stage of examination.

How to Apply for CSC e‑Governance Services Indian Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Recruitment 2026

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online only through the official CSC e‑Governance Services Indian website. Follow the steps given below to submit your application form.

Visit Official Website

  • Go to the official CSC e‑Governance Services Indian website: csc.gov.in.

  • On the homepage, navigate to the Recruitment/Careers/Latest Opening section.

Open Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Application Link

  • Find and click on the notification/link titled “CSC e‑Governance Services Indian Aadhaar Supervisor/ Operator Recruitment 2026” or similar.

  • Click on the Apply Online button to proceed to the application page.

Registration (New Users)

  • Click on New Registration (if applying for the first time).

  • Enter basic details such as Name, Mobile Number, Email ID, Date of Birth, and create a password.

  • Submit the details to generate your Registration ID and Password (note these for future login).

Login and Fill Application Form

  • Login using your Registration ID and Password.

  • Fill in the online application form carefully with personal details, contact details, educational qualification, Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator certificate details, and preferred state/district.

  • Ensure that all details match your certificates and Aadhaar data.

Upload Documents

  • Upload scanned copies of the following documents in the prescribed format and size (as mentioned in the notification):

    • Recent passport size photograph

    • Signature

    • 10th/12th/ITI/Polytechnic Diploma certificates and mark sheets

    • Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor Certificate issued by UIDAI‑authorized Testing & Certifying Agency

    • Any other documents required as per notification

  • Preview the uploaded documents and confirm that they are clear and readable.

Application Fee Payment (If Applicable)

  • Check the Application Fee section in the official notification.

  • If any fee is prescribed, pay it online through available modes such as Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.

  • After successful payment, download/print the fee receipt.

Final Submission

  • Carefully review all the details filled in the application form in the Preview section.

  • If required, make corrections before final submission.

  • Click on Final Submit to complete the application process.

Print Application Form

  • After successful submission, download and take a printout of the final submitted application form for future reference.

  • Keep the Registration ID, Password, and printout safe for further recruitment stages.

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has published Advertisement No. 04/2026 inviting online recruitment applications (ORA) for direct recruitment by selection to various prestigious Group ‘A’ and Group ‘B’ Gazetted posts under different Ministries and Departments of the Government of India. Applications are invited from eligible Indian citizens for filling up these posts on a permanent basis. Interested and eligible candidates can submit their applications online through the UPSC website https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/. The last date for submission of online applications is 29th May 2026 (18:00 Hrs). Candidates are strongly advised to read the complete advertisement carefully, including all instructions, before filling the online application form.

The notification provides complete details on vacancies, reservation, pay scales, age limits, essential/desirable qualifications, experience, duties, probation, headquarters, and other conditions. All candidates are advised to download and thoroughly read the full official notification along with the instructions before applying online.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill the essential educational qualifications and experience as mentioned against each post. Detailed qualifications are available in the official notification. Qualifications are relaxable at the discretion of UPSC for otherwise well-qualified candidates.

Key Highlights:

  • Engineering Faculty Posts require B.E./B.Tech + M.E./M.Tech with first class in relevant discipline.
  • Translator Posts require Bachelor’s Degree in the concerned foreign language or equivalent diploma with English.
  • Administrative & Other Posts require Bachelor’s Degree with relevant experience.
  • PwBD candidates must meet the specified disability criteria.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

  • For all Candidates: Rs. 25/-
  • For SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates: NIL

Details of application fee will be available in the online application portal. Candidates are advised to check the instructions while filling the form. Fee exemption is applicable as per UPSC rules for SC/ST/PwBD/Female candidates (wherever notified).

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Selection will be made on the basis of: - Shortlisting based on essential/desirable qualifications and experience. - Recruitment Test (if conducted). - Personal Interview.
  • Final merit list will be prepared after the interview. Minimum qualifying marks apply for each category.

How to Apply for UPSC Advertisement No. 04/2026

Candidates must apply online only using the UPSC ORA portal: https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/. - First register/create profile (URN). - Fill Common Application Form (CAF). - Fill post-specific module. - Upload required documents, photograph, and signature. - Pay fee (if applicable) and submit.

Documents to be Uploaded:

  • Educational certificates, experience certificates, caste/PwBD certificates, etc. in PDF format.

Prerequisites Before Starting the Application

Before logging into the portal, ensure you have the following ready:

  1. Valid Email ID and Mobile Number – These will be used for all future communication and OTP verification.
  2. Scanned Documents (in PDF format, preferably under 1 MB each):
    • Recent passport-size photograph
    • Signature
    • Matriculation/10th certificate (for Date of Birth proof)
    • All educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
    • Experience certificates (if applicable)
    • Caste/Category certificate (OBC/EWS/SC/ST)
    • PwBD certificate (if applicable)
    • Any other supporting documents mentioned in the notification
  3. Details of all educational qualifications and experience chronologically.
  4. Credit/Debit Card or Net Banking details for payment of application fee (if applicable).
  5. Aadhaar Number (recommended for easier registration).

Important Instructions for UPSC Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Applications received after the closing date or incomplete in any respect will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates must upload clear scanned copies of all supporting documents.
  • Date of birth mentioned in Matriculation certificate will be considered final.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview and must bring original documents.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • UPSC reserves the right to cancel/withdraw any post without assigning any reason.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

  • Scientist-B (Mechanical): A) Master’s Degree in Physics + 1 year practical experience in testing/calibration of engineering materials/products or precision measurements/metrology OR B) B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical/Metallurgical Engineering + 2 years practical experience in testing/calibration of engineering materials/products or precision measurements/metrology (in recognized lab/institute). Desirable: R&D experience in testing of engineering materials and metrology/calibration.
  • Scientific Officer (Non-Destructive): Master’s Degree in Physics OR B.E./B.Tech in Electrical/Mechanical/Metallurgy + 1 year experience in Non-Destructive testing Laboratory OR 1 year experience in X-Ray Diffraction or investigation of failure of Engineering Material by Non-Destructive and metallographic methods.
  • Superintending Archaeological Engineer: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering + Eight years’ experience in Planning, Execution and Supervision of Civil Engineering works in Government Sector or Archaeological/Heritage Sites.
  • Assistant Professor, Civil Engineering (Survey): B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering + M.E./M.Tech in Civil Engineering (Geo Informatics / Geoinformatics and Surveying Technology) with first class or equivalent either at Bachelor’s or Master’s level.

Candidates with Engineering Degree from foreign countries are not eligible to apply.

Indian Army TGC-144 Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for Indian Army TGC-144 Recruitment 2026 consists of multiple successive stages – shortlisting of applications based on cumulative percentage of marks in the Engineering degree (stream-wise), SSB Interview (five days), Medical Examination, Merit List, and issuance of Joining Letter. The final merit list is prepared engineering stream/subject wise on the basis of marks obtained at SSB interview only.

Merely qualifying at the SSB interview does not confirm final selection. If any candidate fails to report within 07 days from the reporting date mentioned in the Joining Letter without prior permission of the concerned academy Adjutant, their candidature will be cancelled and the next candidate in merit will be issued a joining letter.

Stage 1 - Shortlisting of Applications

Basis of Shortlisting Details
Cumulative Percentage of Marks (Stream-wise) Cut-off applied on cumulative percentage of marks upto final semester/year in each Engineering stream. For final year candidates, cumulative percentage upto 6th semester/3rd year must not be below approved cut-off. Shortlisting result to be published in month of June 2026.

Stage 2 - SSB Interview (Five Days)

Stage Details
Stage I Psychological test and Group Testing. Candidates who fail Stage I are returned on the same day.
Stage II Group Testing Officer tests and Interview by Interviewing Officer. Only those clearing Stage I proceed to Stage II.
SSB Centres Prayagraj (UP), Bhopal (MP), Bengaluru (Karnataka), Jalandhar (Punjab)
Likely SSB Dates July to September 2026 (SSB Centre & Date selection window open for two weeks in June 2026)

Stage 3 - Medical Examination

Candidates recommended by SSB will undergo Medical Examination. The validity of SSB medical examination is 270 days (SMB to PCTA joining date). Candidates already declared Med FIT in SSB medical of any service within 270 days need not undergo medical examination again. Medical standards as applicable for Officers Entry into Army. Proceedings of Medical Board are confidential.

Stage 4 - Merit List & Joining Letter

Merit list prepared engineering stream/subject wise on the basis of marks obtained at SSB interview. Tie-break 1: Older candidate ranked higher. Tie-break 2: Higher percentage of marks in degree (as per Para 3). Higher educational qualifications, previous performances etc. have no role. Joining Letters issued subject to vacancies and medical fitness.

Indian Army TGC-144 Recruitment 2026 - Training Details

Selected candidates will be detailed for training at Indian Military Academy (IMA), Dehradun for approximately 12 months (January 2027 to December 2027). On successful completion of training, cadets will be granted Permanent Commission in the rank of Lieutenant. One year ante date seniority from the date of commission will be granted to Engineering Graduates of TGC Entry for the purpose of seniority, promotion, and increment of pay.

Candidates will not be allowed to marry during the period of training. A candidate who marries subsequent to the date of application, though successful at SSB and medical, will not be inducted for training. The cost of training at IMA is at Government expense; candidates withdrawing for personal reasons will be liable to refund at Rs. 16,260/- per week (with 8% annual increment) as per MoD letter No. 16(1)/2017-D(GS.II) dt 15 Mar 22.

Indian Army TGC-144 Recruitment 2026 - Pay & Promotion Structure

On successful commissioning, the pay of the officer shall be fixed at the first cell of Level 10 in the Pay Matrix. The training period shall not be treated as commissioned service. A stipend of Rs. 56,100/- per month is payable during the entire duration of training at IMA, Dehradun. CTC on commissioning is approximately Rs. 17–18 Lakh per annum (excluding free medical cover and travel to home town once a year).
